Hassan Ali Farrukh — Hataff Security

A name that stands for unwavering protection. Hassan Ali Farrukh leads Hataff Security with discipline, vigilance, and complete dedication to safeguarding what matters. Where trust is placed, it is never broken. Every guard, every protocol, every decision is built on the promise to stand firm. They do not falter, they do not retreat — they stand watch so others may rest secure. Strength, integrity, and absolute reliability — this is the standard they uphold.
